Immigration and fertility are the two things I most write about, so this article was probably inevitable. The thrust of it: "we need immigration because of low birth rates" is not only wrong but actively counterproductive; immigration makes the problems of population decline worse, not better. It barely budges population aging, lowers living standards, makes paying pensions harder, not easier, weakens national unity and thus national strength, and erases ethnic groups rather than ensure their continuance. 
Read it below.





Noah Carl: "Once you start looking at the reasons why a growing population might be beneficial, it becomes clear that actually-existing immigration makes the problems of population decline worse, not better." https://www.aporiamagazine.com/p/immigration-does-not-solve-population
